scenario: [LGRA.10.8]: only `emit`, `publish` and `call` take an indented block; under `log` one is a syntax error, and the compiler must refuse it. A `log` line followed by an indented argument line is refused with DS_PARSE_GENERIC. The same rule with no block line compiles (every `log info` action in the corpus), so the refusal is the block's.
